orchestkit · chore/remove-claude-review-workflow

Three workflows propping up a review that never ran once.

Claude PR Review fired on every push to every PR for the repo's entire history and produced zero reviews. Each time it failed, the fix was to build more scaffolding around it rather than ask whether it should exist. Step through what accumulated.

🏷️ Why it skipped 50 times

The pull_request path gated on needs-claude-review, a label nobody had created. A condition that is permanently false renders as "skipped", which reads like coverage while doing nothing. validate-workflows.yml now has a generic dead-gate audit for exactly this, and it still passes with both files removed.

✅ What replaces it

Nothing needs to. ultrareview.yml already does review on the opt-in model (pull_request: [labeled]), carrying its own comment that auto-running on every PR was wasting CI minutes. The lesson was already learned once here; this applies it to the workflow that never got it.




Run counts are the real ones from gh run list --workflow=claude-review.yml
over the last 60 runs. Single file, zero dependencies.
